description: This file defines types and functions for handling delivery context data, including normalization, formatting, merging, and session management for message delivery channels.

methods.name: normalizeDeliveryContext
methods.description: Normalizes a DeliveryContext object by trimming and converting fields to standard formats.

methods.name: formatConversationTarget
methods.description: Formats a conversation target string based on channel and conversation IDs.

methods.name: resolveConversationDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Resolves the delivery target (to and threadId) for a conversation based on parameters.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDeliveryFields
methods.description: Normalizes session delivery fields, merging last known and current delivery contexts.

methods.name: deliveryContextFromSession
methods.description: Creates a DeliveryContext from a session source object.

methods.name: mergeDeliveryContext
methods.description: Merges two DeliveryContext objects, resolving conflicts in channel and route fields.

methods.name: deliveryContextKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a DeliveryContext based on its fields.
